name: grp-mcp-mac
description: Superseded by the grp-mcp plugin, which is cross-platform as of 0.81.0-rc15 and identical to this one; this stays published so existing macOS and Linux installs keep updating. It existed because grp-mcp used to bundle a Windows .exe that a Mac could not execute; both now run the same code from PyPI through uvx, so the split has no purpose left. Install ONE of the two, never both - they register the same server name. Needs uv: 'brew install uv'. Run 'uvx --from grp-mcp-plugin==0.81.0rc25 grp-mcp-setup' once to create your connections file; the server then finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc25): identical to grp-mcp. An approval map can now be changed instead of rebuilt - amount bands on a rule, adding a step with its approver, or removing a step (which takes its approvers with it). Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
